output.summary: Arts is not deprioritised like-for-like: matched-category, matched-priority Arts medians are within 0.3 days of others. SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts tickets) are all routed to P4 and explain 70% of the gap. Most of the remainder comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only technician coverage at Lindqvist, which also affects Education. Non-SlotBook volume is still 1.6x average, so SlotBook does not fully explain volume. Duplicate rates are normal, so trivial or duplicate filing is not the driver. The ACK-P4 template gives requesters no priority or timeframe. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 is undocumented. Best next steps are a written SlotBook support agreement, a fixed acknowledgement and matched reporting. ITS's proposal to put all Arts tickets on P4 and the Dean's desk transfer are not justified.
